title: Model and post-processing parameters for autoware_camera_streampetr

model_params.description: Parameters that describe the ONNX/engine files. Every one of them is required: the node declares them without defaults, and the shapes are cross-checked against the engine's bindings at start-up.

class_names.description: Detection classes, in the channel order of the head's all_cls_scores output.

detection_range.description: [-x, -y, -z, x, y, z] in base_link. Detections outside this box are dropped, because the model was not trained to predict there.

input_image_height.description: Height the images are resized and cropped to before the backbone.

input_image_width.description: Width the images are resized and cropped to before the backbone.

num_proposals.description: Object queries the head emits per frame.

rois_number.description: Number of cameras the model consumes.

pre_memory_length.description: Length of the temporal memory queue fed into the head.

post_memory_length.description: Length of the temporal memory queue the head produces. Not smaller than pre_memory_length.

use_temporal.description: Carry the memory queue across frames. When false the temporal state is wiped after every inference.

backbone_engine_path.description: Serialized backbone engine. Empty means backbone_path with a .engine extension, built on demand.

head_engine_path.description: Serialized head engine. Empty means head_path with a .engine extension, built on demand.

position_embedding_engine_path.description: Serialized position embedding engine. Empty means position_embedding_path with a .engine extension, built on demand.

workspace_size.description: TensorRT workspace as a power of two, in bytes. 32 means 4 GB.

confidence_threshold.description: Per-class score threshold, in the same order as model_params.class_names.

circle_nms_dist_threshold.description: Distance on the xy plane below which the lower-scoring box is suppressed. 0 turns circle NMS off.

iou_nms_search_distance_2d.description: Only box pairs closer than this are considered by the IoU NMS.

iou_nms_threshold.description: BEV IoU above which the lower-scoring box is suppressed. 0 turns IoU NMS off.

yaw_norm_thresholds.description: Per-class minimum norm of the predicted (sin, cos) yaw pair; below it the detection is dropped as unreliable. Same order as model_params.class_names.
